CHANGED: automaticDiscounts query removed in Admin API 2027-01 [Shopify]. Replacement: discountNodes with query: "method:automatic". The automaticDiscounts query no longer exists on QueryRoot in Admin GraphQL API version 2027-01, so a request that includes it fails validation instead of returning data. The DiscountAutomaticConnection and DiscountAutomaticEdge types go with it. Apps on 2026-10 and earlier keep working while those versions are supported. Shopify ties the removal to API version 2027-01 and gives no calendar date.
  Guide: https://shopify.dev/changelog/automaticdiscounts-query-is-removed-in-api-version-2027-01
